title: pre-commit unused-media hook (dev/find-unused-media.sh): set always_run so deletion-only commits still run the repo-wide check
answers: Why didn't the unused media check fail when I deleted the last doc that referenced an image?
How do I make a repo-wide pre-commit hook run even when no staged file matches its pattern?
Where is the unused media check configured now that the separate lint.yml step is gone?
How do I add a pre-commit hook that ignores filenames (pass_filenames: false)?
body:
Path: .pre-commit-config.yaml (the `unused-media` hook, entry dev/find-unused-media.sh) runs the repo-wide scan for media files that no doc or reference uses; it runs in CI through `pre-commit run --all-files` and locally on commit.
Rule: a hook with `pass_filenames: false` that checks whole-repo state rather than the staged files must set `always_run: true`. pre-commit skips hooks whose matched files are absent and excludes deleted paths from its candidate list, so a commit that only deletes the last reference to a media file would otherwise never trigger the check.
Symptom: a commit that removed the last document referencing an image could land without the unused-media check flagging the now-orphaned media file.
Constraints: applies to filename-independent hooks only; file-scoped hooks should keep normal triggering. `always_run` is the fix for this hook; the dedicated lint.yml step it replaced was removed, so the pre-commit config is now the single source for this check.
applies: Adding or editing pre-commit hooks in .pre-commit-config.yaml that take no filename arguments, especially repo-wide media/doc consistency checks.
says: Removing a document referencing an image did not trigger the unused image check.
Orphaned screenshots stay in the repository when pull request checks skip image validation.
Make the unused media check run when someone only deletes documentation pages.
Deleting the last article linking to a diagram failed to flag unreferenced media.
Repository media checks should catch leftover pictures even if no files were added.
search: In .pre-commit-config.yaml, repository-wide pre-commit hooks that use pass_filenames: false, such as dev/find-unused-media.sh, must set always_run: true so deletion-only commits trigger the check. Because pre-commit excludes deleted paths and skips hooks when matching files are absent, removing the last doc referencing a media file otherwise lands without flagging the orphaned media. This rule applies only to filename-independent hooks, while file-scoped hooks keep normal triggering. The unused-media pre-commit hook is now the single source for this check following the removal of the separate lint.yml step.
